fusions.name: Coop Quake
fusions.desc: Stamps the floor in a ring, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for each ally beside you, up to 32%.

fusions.name: Final Nail
fusions.desc: A hammering peck at a target at or below 30% health that deals 22 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Ring the Anvil
fusions.desc: A clanging challenge that draws up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Beaten Soft
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
